components.heading: Pay on termination.
components.text: Any employee who is terminated or who voluntarily resigns shall receive their earned wages not later than the next regular payday upon which they would have been paid if still employed. (Ord. 20206 § 28, 9-10-19. Code 1981 § 31-259. Code 1995 § 106-77. Formerly 2.125.230.)
